newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes lower on setback, basis stays up.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes lower on setback, basis stays up.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower on a setback after the rally early this week to contract highs, but the cash rice basis market held firm, traders said.
"The market just returned to near the level before the stocks report (USDA January stocks)," a trader said. "It was a high volume week with the market hit by speculative long liquidation."
Traders said the cash basis market was strong despite the late-week drop in soybean futures. The open interest in rice continued to increase indicating an ongoing bullish scenario for rice prices.
"The Freedom to Farm Act has resulted in more pricing on the board," a trader said.
Rice futures volume was estimated by the CBOT at 450 contracts, below the 648 traded Thursday.
Rice futures closed one to 18 cents per cwt lower, with March down 18 at $11.69.
